answer: One threshold for every key: Parchment packer deerskin proof stretched on the drying loft, and one receipt, each deerskin is a season of stretched skins plus a signed parchment record, no matter whose hand carries it. One clone costs 155 POA and 11 minutes to raise; 569 clones cost 88195 POA and 6259 minutes each epoch to keep. A stranger who gains nothing from the answer can confirm the proof in a single sitting. The panel reads the jade for a name, the zephyr for a number, the anchor for a date, then asks the farm to account for all three at once.
